title: RPCS3 0.0.32-16611: official stable release
summary: RPCS3 published 0.0.32-16611 on June 14, 2024. The release record documents an official stable release for the PlayStation 3 emulator project.

blocks.text: The RPCS3 project published version 0.0.32-16611 on June 14, 2024. GitHub marks this entry as a release; this distinction is preserved here so the build is not mistaken for a different update channel.

The release record publishes a SHA-256 checksum (115a7b12a54cf420d01f84548f0752446b8f3aeee945152c7c55145488fac118) and records an archive size of 29485739 bytes, approximately 29.5 MB. These values identify the distributed build without relying on an external summary.
